To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MBT has been widely used for testing SPLs, and that there is a wide variety of MBT approaches and tools that can be used for testing SPL.

MBT has been applied to Software and Automotive domains; most of MBT solutions for SPLs are fully automated; variability is considered by the majority of studies; Finite State Machine and Scenario-based models are the most used; Behavioral-based models are more used than Structure-based models; Case Studies, Experiments and Surveys are the most used to evaluate MB T solutions; the majority of MBT solutions are performed in industrial environments and most of studies are performed in Europe.
MBT of SPL can be applied in different domains, and that the majority of the research is performed on the automotive and software domains.

the following research questions: (1) What is the state of the art in model-based testing of SPLs?
the state-of-the-art of MBT in SPLs.

MBT of SPL is an emerging area of research, with many open challenges and opportunities.
the state-of-the-art of MBT of SPL is still in its infancy.
MBT of SPL is a promising research area, which still requires further research to address some open challenges.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a need for further research on variability and its management in MBT solutions for SPLs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the research community should focus on the following topics: (i) variability management and traceability, (ii) formal artifacts for MBT and (iii) automation and tool support.
